learned_selector_rule: opens only above a measured residual lower bound over the strongest simple rule; refused otherwise
permitted_information_rule: a perspective reads its declared regions through the workspace, so an undeclared read is refused by the type system

catalog.name: direct
catalog.objective: predict the label from the current observation alone
catalog.confidence: calibrated frequency over held out units
failure_modes: confidently wrong on a shifted distribution
catalog.verification: held out accuracy against the same units

catalog.name: temporal
catalog.objective: read a trend out of the persistent temporal state
catalog.confidence: calibrated frequency over held out units
failure_modes: reports a trend across a reset boundary
catalog.verification: misaligned reset control must lose the trend

catalog.name: precedent
catalog.objective: reuse the outcome of the most similar past episode
catalog.confidence: calibrated frequency over held out units
catalog.verification: similarity ablation must degrade the outcome

catalog.name: critic
catalog.objective: object to the current decision where uncertainty is unresolved
catalog.confidence: calibrated frequency over held out units
failure_modes: objects to everything and so discriminates nothing
catalog.verification: objection rate must vary with the injected error rate

catalog.name: counterexample
catalog.objective: refute a stated rule by finding a case it does not cover
catalog.confidence: calibrated frequency over held out units
failure_modes: misses a counterexample outside the stored concept set
catalog.verification: a planted counterexample must be found

catalog.name: uncertainty
catalog.objective: summarize how wide the current beliefs are
catalog.confidence: calibrated frequency over held out units
failure_modes: summarizes an empty interval set as certainty
catalog.verification: widening an interval must widen the summary

honest_gap: a family with no implementation has no evidence and is listed as missing rather than as available
